title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Duo #16 (KlimtMosaic+JapaneseKutani+UkrainianPetrykivka+NorwegianRosemaling / JapaneseMakie+HungarianKalocsa+EscherTessellation+UkrainianPysanka)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, cheerful, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates one zone. Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands, dense overglaze florals) dominates the second zone. Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands, dense folk-art florals) dominates the third zone. Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense acanthus scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto peep-toe heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Russian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, cool and composed, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, matte finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder, wide gold-powder bands, dense gold powder glittering densely) dominates one zone. Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands, dense folk-art floral motifs) dominates the second zone. Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands, dense morphing tessellation) dominates the third zone. Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands, dense geometric wax-resist linework) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto knee-high boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
